question: Can you calculate the median from the highest season goals of each team?
sql:
-- Verify the distribution of highest season goals per team
WITH match_goals AS (
    SELECT season, home_team AS team, home_team_goal AS goals FROM match_view
    UNION ALL
    SELECT season, away_team AS team, away_team_goal AS goals FROM match_view
),
team_season_goals AS (
    SELECT season, team, SUM(goals) AS total_goals
    FROM match_goals
    GROUP BY season, team
),
max_goals_per_team AS (
    SELECT team, MAX(total_goals) AS highest_season_goals
    FROM team_season_goals
    GROUP BY team
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS num_teams,
    MIN(highest_season_goals) AS min_goals,
    MAX(highest_season_goals) AS max_goals,
    AVG(highest_season_goals) AS avg_goals,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY highest_season_goals) AS median_goals
FROM max_goals_per_team
